name: Week 14 KB Conditioning — Back to Thursday, Full Template (Spotlight: Figure-8 → Tactical Clean)
description: KB Conditioning returns to Thursday (W13 Saturday-experiment ends). dayOverview.theme: Thursday KB day, full template. Lighter on loaded squatting (Friday legs is tomorrow). Spotlight = figure-8 → tactical clean flow. Bent press lives inside the light OTD flow; TGU and windmill are maintenance.

spotlights.why: The figure-8 → tactical clean flow has been the W12D4 favorite and ran through W13. Spotlight refresh drills the EXIT into clean — the pass doesn't return to a hand; the catch IS the clean. The skill being trained is the seamless figure-8-to-rack transition.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W10 bent press · W11 windmill · W12 TGU · W13 bent press refresh · W14 figure-8 flow (current) · W15 cycle forward — windmill or TGU refresh.
watchpoints: **Back to Thursday.** W13's Saturday experiment ends. Thursday = day before Friday legs, so the loaded squatting (goblet, OH squat) stays light here.
**New full template runs both KB days** — banded prep → strength → flow → mobility → cooldown.
**Figure-8 flow spotlight** — 2-3 rounds of 60s. The pass EXITS INTO the clean — no mid-pass hand catch.
**Right shoulder watch on the figure-8 rack catch** — if it talks, drop to figure-8 passes only and finish the round.
**Thursday strength block stays light** — single-arm work + light volume. The heavy strength work is Tuesday's job. **Goblet squats kept light** (don't fatigue legs the day before Friday).

**Finisher is a light Flow + Balance block, not a metabolic complex.** Thursday is conditioning + skills + balance, not brutal finishing — and Friday legs is tomorrow. Overhead-extension-to-halo flow, single-leg RDL balance, bird-dog. Light bell, no loaded squatting.

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 15-20lb. Slow circles, both directions. Shoulder loosener.
Standing, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension — wakes the grip and forearms for the figure-8 + clean catches.

sets.name: Banded Shoulder Prep (~3 min)

exercises.notes: Mini-band overhead OR blue rope band gripped in hands.
Elbows drive to the ribs, scaps depress.
Press out to a T — fires rear delts and mid-traps.
Pull apart at the sternum, scaps retract, ribs down.
Sweep arms back. Don't overarch.
15s each side. Primes the lateral hinge.
Both arms in a V/Y overhead. Hold and breathe — lower traps fire.

sets.notes: 1 round of all 7 banded moves (~3 min). Sustained tension, no rest between positions.

sets.name: Strength Block (Lighter — Thursday Variant)

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 30lb. 2 rounds, 8 each side. Hips hinged, back flat, pull elbow to hip.

**LOAD:** 25-30lb. 2 rounds, 5 each side. Single-arm strict press — clean to rack, press straight up.
- **Ribs DOWN** before the press — no rib flare
- **Bicep finishes by the ear, full lockout**
- Slow descent back to rack

sets.notes: Lighter strength block — single-arm row + press, the bigger compound presses (C&P) are Tuesday's job. ~5 min.

sets.name: OTD Flow (Light Groove — Skill Practice)

exercises.notes: Bell starts on the floor between the feet, hips drive the lift, catch in the rack with the knees slightly bent.
Goblet/rack position. **LIGHT** — Thursday before Friday legs, keep depth without grinding. Sit tall, full depth, no bouncing.
Stride out wide, sit into the working leg, keep the other leg long. Mobility, not strength.

The deliberate leverage move inside the flow — **the body goes DOWN, the bell barely moves.** From the rack, hinge and rotate AWAY from the bell side, eyes tracking the bell, until the arm locks out overhead — you lower your body under the bell, you don't press it up. Slow and smooth; it's leverage, not a press.
Control on the way down — bell to the floor as cleanly as it came up. Closes the flow before switching sides.

sets.notes: **This is a continuous FLOW, not separate stations.** Move through the full chain on ONE side — dead clean → front squat → lateral lunge → bent press → tactical clean — letting each move feed the next, then repeat the whole flow on the other side. About 2 reps' worth at each move, don't stop to count. **~20-25lb throughout, 2 rounds. Light groove** — it should feel effortless. Friday legs is tomorrow.

sets.name: 🔆 Figure-8 → Tactical Clean Flow (Spotlight)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 25lb. 3 rounds of 60s continuous flow.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — the exit-into-clean cue:**
- **START in the hike position** (bell between the legs, hinged at the hips)
- **Figure-8 → exit into a tactical clean to rack** — pass between the legs, hand catches BEHIND, the pull becomes the clean
- **The figure-8 EXITS into the clean** — the bell does not return to a hand mid-pass; the catch becomes the clean. This is the skill.
- Lower the bell back through the hike position; the next pass switches sides
- Continue alternating for the full 60s

**Cues:**
- **Tactical clean = controlled, threaded into the rack** — no yank, no forearm slam
- **Hike is home base** — every transition resets through hike
- **Right shoulder watch on the rack catch** — if it talks, drop to figure-8 passes only and finish the round

**Reflection:** does the pass→clean feel like one motion, or two? The skill is the seamless transition — if there's a hand catch between the pass and the clean, the cue's broken.

**Dose: 3 rounds at 25lb.** Volume restored from W13's 2 rounds — this is the spotlight, deeper drill at slightly more volume.

sets.notes: Spotlight skill flow. 3 rounds at 25lb, ~5 min including rest.

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 25-30lb. 2 rounds. Maintenance — spotlight was W12 + W13 refresh.
- **Straight-arm overhead lockout** — arm stays locked vertical the whole way
- Eyes ON the bell every checkpoint
- Pause at every checkpoint — reverse is half the lift
- Hip bridge: glute squeeze, ribs down

**LOAD:** 18-20lb. 2 rounds. Maintenance.
- Bell locked overhead, eyes track the bell
- **Hip hinge AWAY from the bell side**
- **Stretch lives in the back leg's hip flexor, NOT the lower back**
- Slow descent, brief pause, controlled return

**LOAD:** 15-20lb. New from W13D6 — 'super tiring super quick.'
- **Stand on one leg, knee soft, opposite leg lifted slightly**
- Pass the bell around the body — hand to hand behind / in front
- **Standing-leg glute LOCKED IN** — hip drives stability, not the spine
- 5 reps clockwise, 5 reps counter-clockwise, then switch legs
- **Torso quiet** — the bell tries to pull you into rotation; resist

sets.name: Flow + Balance — Light Skill Practice

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 15-20lb. Flowing overhead tricep extension into a halo — one continuous shape, thoracic + shoulder opener under light load. **Flow, don't grind** — smooth circles, ribs down. Right shoulder watch: keep it light and loosening; back off range if it pinches.

**LOAD:** 15-20lb. Single-leg balance + hip hinge. **The point is balance and control, not load** — keep it light so legs stay fresh for Friday. Standing-leg glute locked, hips square, slow reach to the floor and back. The wobble is the training.
Bodyweight. Slow anti-rotation balance — opposite arm + leg extend, hold 2s, hips stay square (no rotation). Resets the spine after the figure-8 and single-leg work.

sets.notes: Light flow + balance, 2 rounds, ~5 min. Thursday is conditioning + skill + balance — keep it flowing and light; nothing here should pre-fatigue legs for Friday.

exercises.notes: 60s each side. Hip flexor release — counters the TGU hip bridge and lateral lunge work.
60s. Adductors get tight from lateral lunges and figure-8 stance.

**Spotlight: figure-8 → tactical clean flow** (3 rounds at 25lb). The pass EXITS INTO the clean.
**Strength block on Thursday is lighter** — single-arm row + press only (no C&P, that's Tuesday).
**Finisher = light Flow + Balance block** (overhead-extension-to-halo, single-leg RDL, bird-dog) — flow and balance, not a metabolic complex. Keeps legs fresh for Friday.

**Right shoulder watch on the figure-8 rack catch** — drop to passes only if it talks.

formPhilosophy: Thursday KB day, full template, lighter dose on the loaded squatting because Friday legs is the day after. Figure-8 spotlight drills the exit-into-clean skill — fun flow, useful cue, three rounds of focused practice. Thursday's intent is conditioning + skill + balance, so the session closes on a light flow + balance block rather than a metabolic finisher — flowing technique work that won't pre-fatigue legs for Friday. Building decades, not weeks.
